name: preferences-vocab
description: A vocabulary for expressing individual preferences and verified contact information

scripts.move: mv vocabulary.html dist/index.html && mv vocabulary.context.jsonld vocabulary.jsonld vocabulary.ttl dist/
scripts.release: bash -c 'VERSION=$0; npm run build && cp dist/vocabulary.context.jsonld "dist/contexts/$VERSION.jsonld" && git add -f dist/contexts/$VERSION.jsonld'
